name: LDM-MENU
description: Low graphics & LDM menu with CPS/FPS labels, cheat indicator, and up to 240 FPS cap.

low-graphics.name: Low Graphics / LDM
low-graphics.description: Enables low detail mode and reduces visual effects.

show-hud.name: Show CPS, FPS & Indicator
show-hud.description: Displays CPS counter, FPS counter, and cheat status dot.

fps-limit.name: FPS Limit (Max 240)
fps-limit.description: Target frame rate cap between 30 and 240 FPS.
